# Packages excluded from license-allowlist enforcement.
#
# Each entry is `name@version` as reported by `license-checker`. Add a brief
# justification for every entry below — the list is intentionally narrow so
# unexpected copyleft dependencies still trip the License compliance check.
#
# - @img/sharp-libvips-*@1.2.4: prebuilt libvips binaries shipped by the
#   `sharp` image-processing library. libvips itself is LGPL-3.0; we
#   consume it dynamically (not statically linked into our distributable),
#   which is permitted by LGPL-3.0 §4. Reviewed and accepted.
# - gsap@3.15.0: GSAP's "Standard 'no charge' license". Not OSI-approved but
#   explicitly free for all commercial use (Webflow made GSAP 100% free in
#   2025, https://gsap.com/pricing/). No copyleft obligations. Reviewed and
#   accepted for the showcase homepage hero animation.
gsap@3.15.0
@img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64@1.2.4
@img/sharp-libvips-darwin-x64@1.2.4
@img/sharp-libvips-linux-arm64@1.2.4
